issues.description: Default base image string 'python:3.12' is duplicated across three or four locations, defeating the RPC's single-source-of-truth purpose.
issues.detail: The literal lives in pipeline.py, Commands.ts catch-fallback, CellMetadataEditor.tsx as DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE, and previously in the Jinja template. The RPC was supposed to centralize this; instead it added more copies. Bumping the Python version now requires editing multiple files in sync. Pick one authoritative source and have the rest derive from it.

issues.description: Silent behavior change: empty base_image now becomes python:3.12 instead of deferring to KFP's default.
issues.detail: Previously self.base_image = '' on the ApiException/fallback path let KFP pick its own default. This patch pins it to DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE, conflating UI display default with compile/execution default. That is a runtime behavior change for every user whose pod lookup fails, smuggled inside a UI patch. Split it out, justify it, or revert.

issues.description: RPC round-trip to ship a single constant string is incidental complexity.
issues.detail: get_default_base_image returns a module-level literal that the frontend already hardcodes as fallback. It adds network failure modes, async state, try/catch, and a lazy in-function import for no benefit. Either bake it into the labextension build, fold it into an existing settings/config RPC, or drop the RPC entirely.

issues.description: Replacing an inline base-image Input with a modal behind a cryptic 'IMAGE' button is a UX regression.
issues.detail: The previous UI exposed the value as editable data on the surface. The new flow hides it behind a click, gates the button on stepName being non-empty (an unrelated coupling), and adds dialog state to the component. Users now need a modal to see what image will run --- more clicks, less information density, for the same field.

issues.description: Button width '5%' with text 'IMAGE' is a layout claim without measurement.
issues.detail: Setting style width:'5%' on a contained MUI Button containing 'IMAGE' will overflow, truncate, or look broken at common panel widths. Use minWidth and let content size the button, or measure the rendered width across the panel's resize range before committing to a percentage.

issues.description: createBaseImageText precedence chain is undocumented and conflates 'unset' with 'matches default'.
issues.detail: The four-level fallback (baseImage -> pipelineBaseImage -> defaultBaseImage -> literal) is now load-bearing for what users see, yet the precedence is not stated anywhere. The '(default)' label fires whenever this.props.baseImage is falsy, even when pipelineBaseImage overrides --- reporting on identity while displaying a value. Add a literate comment and disambiguate the label.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this PR is sold as a UI tweak but smuggles a backend behavior change and scatters a single fact across multiple files. The most serious issues are the silent conversion of empty base_image to python:3.12 in the ApiException fallback path, and the duplication of that literal across pipeline.py, Commands.ts, and CellMetadataEditor.tsx --- both of which defeat the RPC's stated single-source-of-truth purpose. The RPC itself is incidental complexity for shipping one constant string, and the UI regression (inline Input replaced by a modal behind an 'IMAGE' button gated on stepName) trades visible affordance for clicks. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK. Split into separate patches, centralize the default, document the precedence chain, and reconsider whether the modal is genuinely better than the inline editor.
